input.quote: 10.2 Additional Representations and Warranties of Harpoon. Except as set forth on Schedule 10.2, Harpoon further represents and warrants to AbbVie, as of the Effective Date, as follows:
input.rationale: Article 10 contains only mutual and Harpoon-specific representations given "as of the Effective Date" (10.1, 10.2) plus covenants (10.3, 10.4). The closest performance standard, Section 3.8.4 ("in good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law"), is a mutual compliance covenant, not a conformance warranty, and carries no remedy. Nothing warrants that Harpoon's deliverables or any software conform to their documentation, and no repair, replacement or refund remedy exists (searches for "conform", "re-perform" and "refund" return only tax and indemnity mechanics). The disclaimer at 10.5 preserves "THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH HEREIN", so it needs no carve-out edit — but there is nothing for it to preserve. This fails the fallback on material terms, so we inserted the shortest express warranty at fallback level: 90 days for software/deliverables, 30 days for Harpoon's Development activities, with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund. Because Sections 6.1 through 6.4 make payments "non-refundable", the remedy sentence opens with a narrow override so the refund leg is not read as inoperative; the services leg also reaches Harpoon's other Development activities so the warranty is not under-inclusive. We did not take the preferred 12-month software period, 90-day services period, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code elements.

ops.text: Performance Warranty. Harpoon warrants that (a) for ninety (90) days following delivery, any software and other deliverables provided by Harpoon to AbbVie hereunder will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and (b) for thirty (30) days following performance, the Initial Development Activities and any other Development activities performed by Harpoon hereunder will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Notwithstanding any provision of this Agreement stating that payments are non-refundable, including Sections 6.1 through 6.4, for breach of this warranty Harpoon shall, at AbbVie's election, repair or replace the non-conforming deliverable, re-perform the non-conforming activities, or refund the amounts paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 10 gives us only as-of-Effective-Date representations, with no conformance warranty for Harpoon's deliverables or Development activities and no remedy for non-conforming work. We added a short express warranty at our fallback position (90 days for software and other deliverables, 30 days for Harpoon's Development activities) with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund, and we open the remedy with a narrow override so the refund is not defeated by the non-refundable payment language in Sections 6.1 through 6.4.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.6 express performance warranty: 90-day conformance for software/deliverables, 30-day warranty for Harpoon's Development activities, with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund, and a targeted override of the non-refundable payment language in Sections 6.1-6.4.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
